proposal_preferences: Propose one exact appended instruction, not a collection of optional tips
Prioritize checks by expected correctness information per unit of remaining time
Use a simple decision rule an agent can follow without maintaining a large artifact
Keep the control arm identical except for the appended instruction
Separate a plausible causal mechanism from any unmeasured effectiveness claim
evaluation_criteria: Complete held-out task pass rate under a fixed hard deadline
Regression count measured by an external fresh-checkout grader
Deadline-miss rate as a preregistered noninferiority guardrail
Tool calls, wall time, and cost per assigned trial
Compliance with the specified verification-priority rule
generation_methods: Generate contrasting mechanisms: risk-weighted micro-probes, staged test ladders, and counterexample-first checks
Translate each mechanism into one copy-pastable imperative instruction
Derive concrete failure risks and falsifying outcomes before ranking
Reject proposals whose bookkeeping likely costs as much as the verification they prioritize
evolution_strategies: Compress multi-step policies into a single bounded decision rule
Replace vague risk language with observable prioritization criteria
Remove redundant broad test runs and unbounded iteration
Revise claims to match available evidence and retain explicit failure modes
constraints: Exactly one appended system-prompt instruction is the treatment
No autonomous source changes outside isolated pre-authorized trial workspaces
No claim of measured improvement without held-out benchmark results
Identical model, context, tools, seeds policy, and hard deadline across arms
No access to hidden graders, other-arm outputs, credentials, or unrelated files
Human review is required before applying any generated patch outside the trial
termination_criteria: A single intervention is selected with an operational prioritization rule
Primary outcome and deadline noninferiority guardrail are preregistered
At least three concrete failure risks are recorded
The final text makes no unsupported empirical claim
Provider-call budget or configured research-cycle limit is reached
